title: LiftBig global exercises
description: Global exercises the API seeds on every start (ProgramSeeder). A name that already exists as a global, in any letter case, is kept with its id; a missing category or equipment is filled in, and the video and image keys are set to what this file gives (null or left out clears them). Removing an entry does not delete the exercise.

name.description: Shown in the exercise picker. Unique, ignoring letter case.

category.description: Picker category chip; null lists the exercise under "Other".

equipment.description: Shown in the picker row's subtitle.

videoKey.description: Demo video: the object key in the media bucket (ADR 0026), e.g. exercises/snatch-v1.mp4. Lower-case, .mp4 or .webm, never a URL. Optional; null or left out means none.

imageKey.description: Picker thumbnail: the object key in the media bucket, e.g. exercises/snatch-v1.webp. Lower-case, .jpg, .png or .webp. Optional; null or left out means none.
